sources.label: Patches for some apps I use myself.
sources.author: jzl1
patch_list: Allows LTE Discovery to run on virtual Android devices by forcing the single Build.*-based emulator predicate to false. Opt-in; only needed on emulators.
Unlocks Pro and Pro Plus features by forcing the two client-side BillingEntitlements predicates to true. Also disables Google PairIP App Licensing so the repackaged build can start.

Marks the Pro Plus / Donate (e6) tier as owned. It does not add any feature beyond Pro Plus - the only visible effect is the 'Pro Plus / Donate' label and the supporter badge. Requires Unlock Pro. Disabled by default.
